efficacy_outcome: Across 26 RCTs (2,375 patients), silymarin improved several measures, including ALT (SMD −12.39, 95% CI −19.69 to −5.08), AST (SMD −10.97, 95% CI −15.51 to −6.43), and hepatic steatosis (OR 3.25, 95% CI 1.80–5.87). HOMA-IR was not significantly changed (SMD −0.37, 95% CI −0.77 to 0.04).
